choices: It joins line_items into the invoice query so a single SQL statement returns both
It loads the line items of all returned invoices with one extra query, instead of one lazy query per invoice during the list comprehension

questions.prompt: Two workers call record_payment for the same invoice at the same time, with different payment ids and amounts that together exceed the balance. What happens?
choices: Both payments are applied, because each worker reads the balance before the other commits
The second worker blocks on the row lock until the first commits, then sees the updated balance and may raise PaymentRejected
The second worker's commit raises a stale-data error and must be retried by the caller
Both workers fail because with_for_update takes a table-level lock

choices: The returned Invoice can be read after the session commits without triggering a refresh query for its attributes
Changes made to the Invoice after the commit are automatically flushed
